A0.relaxed: Bonjour, and welcome to French for Professionals. This course begins at the very beginning, and no previous French is required. You have chosen a relaxed pace: a few lessons a week, each given time to settle. Steady, regular practice is what builds lasting skill. Each lesson places you in a real workplace situation, and you take the part of the professional. Listen carefully, speak aloud, and aim for clarity rather than perfection. When you are ready, we shall begin. Commençons.
